release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.45.34 streamlines the desktop navigation and finishes the latest Tasks polish. The main sidebar is reduced to seven primary destinations: Dashboard, Drops, Tasks, Profiles, Accounts, Proxies, and Settings. Orders, Automation, Operations, and Diagnostics are now available as Settings sub-sections, while Owner Vault and Announcements expand to use the reclaimed sidebar space. Tasks now orders modules as Pokémon Center, Walmart, Amazon, Target, Login Cookies, and ATC Cookies; the New Task Group picker uses the same layout with Target in the bottom-left, retailer placeholders are replaced with recognizable retailer marks, and leaving a selected group returns the workspace to the standard Select a task group landing screen. No task execution, checkout, cookie/session, or retail backend behavior was changed.
